column1: # GuiAssets batch: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# com.desertstormfront.ui.hud.GuiAssets - the global UI asset registry (static typed accessors).
# The fonts (fontDokchampa15...), defaultFont, flagRegions, clickSound and the get* / resolve*
# methods are already meaningfully named, so they are not in this map. Only the anonymous
# widget-style / nine-patch accessors are renamed, each confirmed from its call sites:
#   m/ButtonStyle -> productionButtonStyle: the 6 production-choice buttons in BuildingPanel top row.
#   n/ButtonStyle -> fullCountButtonStyle : state source copied onto a full sub-unit button (BuildingPanel a()).
#   w/CheckboxStyle -> checkboxStyle     : the only CheckboxStyle built.
# The remaining single-letter accessors (other NinePatch/ButtonStyle/TextureRegion/assets) have no
# distinguishable role from the call sites and are deliberately left obfuscated.
